grades.quote: Spin-locks are best suited to short critical sections, since waiting for them wastes CPU time; sleep-locks work well for lengthy operations.
grades.reason: Directly compares spinlocks and sleep-locks. Spinning wastes CPU during long waits and cannot yield, while sleep-locks yield the CPU while waiting but can't be used in interrupt handlers or spinlock critical sections. It also says when each type fits best.
